claims.statement: For the genuine Boolean OR-of-point-defects family with r-bit blocks and k=2^r blocks, G-I=4 exp(-1) r^2 2^(-r)+O(r 2^(-r)); hence G>I for all sufficiently large r.
claims.prior_bound: G/I tended to 1 with an unsigned O(r 2^(-r)) error.
claims.gu_implication: The universal GU pair (a,b)=(1,0) is refuted; GU itself remains open because boundary pairs with b>0 survive this family asymptotically.
not_claimed: an unbounded G/I, U/I, or H/I ratio
failure of every pair with a+b=1
